propositions: Packaged prose guides cite criterion ids inline without mechanical coupling to the registry, allowing criterion text to change silently while guide paraphrases become stale.

A guide parity gate must detect when a cited criterion's text changes by pinning digests of authoritative criterion registry text and failing on digest mismatch, forcing re-verification before regeneration.
The citation extraction mechanism must depend only on the closed vocabulary of criterion ids at word boundaries and no guide markup, so ordinary prose edits and restructuring do not break the gate.
The gate must report four failure classes: unknown citations (missing from registry), stale pins (criterion text changed), orphan pins (cited no longer), and missing manifest.
The gate runs without a new CI step by composition into the existing validate-routing workflow, which already invokes plan_review registry validation.
